import bpy,contextlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
ec=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Export'];ec.hide_viewport=False;ec.hide_render=False
for ob in ec.objects:
 bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=ob
 for mod in list(ob.modifiers):
  if mod.type=='TRIANGULATE':bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
# Keep RNA node-tree identities alive throughout the exporter traversal.
bpy.app.driver_namespace['sp13_export_tree_refs']=[m.node_tree for m in bpy.data.materials if m.use_nodes]
with (root/'captures/surface_pass_20261113/yard_export.log').open('w',encoding='utf8') as log:
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(log),contextlib.redirect_stderr(log):
  payload=json.loads((root/'source/surface_pass_10_export_yard.mcp.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
  exec(payload['code'].replace('export_apply=True','export_apply=False'))
ec.hide_viewport=True;ec.hide_render=True
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('SP13_YARD_NORMALS_EXPORTED')
